annotations.title: Batch Extract Custom JSON Across Multiple Documents

description: Extract structured JSON matching one shared `schema` across 2 to 5 document URLs in a single batch call (max 15 MB per file). Partial failures are isolated per item: if one URL fails to download or parse, remaining documents still succeed and return per-file status. Use when normalizing multiple homogeneous documents (e.g., a batch of vendor bills or receipts) into the same schema. For a single document, use `extract_document_json` instead. Requires a valid `api_key` (or `x-api-key` header) and deducts 1 credit per successfully processed page.

api_key.description: Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`). Required unless already supplied via the `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` request header.

file_urls.description: Array of 2 to 5 public HTTP/HTTPS URLs pointing to PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or TIFF documents (max 15 MB each).

schema.description: Shared non-empty target JSON template or JSON Schema applied identically to every document in `file_urls`.

name: extract_document_batch

creditsRemaining.description: Remaining API key credit balance after batch completion.

failedCount.description: Number of documents that failed download or extraction.

results.description: Ordered per-document extraction outcomes matching the input `file_urls` order.

succeededCount.description: Number of documents extracted without error.

totalRequested.description: Number of document URLs submitted in `file_urls`.
